verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a developer SaaS tool like Mirrors, but the evidence never documents acting on many corrections, sessions, or traces in a single operation. Previewing one correction against stored conversations and spotting mistakes that repeat across runs are analysis features, not bulk actions. The docs also stress updating corrections one at a time.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
